objective: Find the lowest-cost evidence-acquisition policy that preserves most of CG-5's decision quality while retaining a topology advantage over an evidence-using flat baseline. The acquisition policy may use mission requirements and reconciled observed evidence only; evaluator capability is diagnostics-only.
interpretation_boundary: This calibration reuses the already-unblinded CG-5 fresh cohort and therefore cannot support a new confirmatory claim. Its only purpose is to freeze one acquisition architecture and budget for a later untouched CG-6 cohort.

society.common_random_probe_rule: All acquisition policies draw from the same deterministic supplemental event table used by the CG-5 fixed-six replay: event ids are cg4m-probe:<field>:<agent>:<skill>:<event_index>, and timestamps are the positions those events occupy in the full fixed-six traversal. Policies differ only in which events they acquire.

context.retrieval: CG-5 revised coverage graph with event reconciliation and complete three-claim evidence bundles.
context.flat_baseline: CG-5 bundle-aware flat retrieval over the exact same acquired evidence and matched context budget.

acquisition.uniform_round_robin: At each acquisition step, probe an available agent-skill cell with the smallest reconciled event count; break ties by a deterministic field/agent/skill hash. This is the cost-matched non-adaptive measurement baseline.
acquisition.uncertainty_only: At each step, choose the available cell with the widest 80-percent Wilson interval; add a support-deficit term for cells below three independent events; break ties deterministically. Mission pair selection is not consulted.
acquisition.decision_adaptive: At each step, compute conservative CG-5 pair choices from current reconciled evidence. Prioritize cells by Wilson interval width, minimum-support deficit, whether the cell is in a currently selected mission role, and whether its optimistic Wilson bound can plausibly challenge the incumbent conservative role score. Evaluator capability and oracle pairs are forbidden inputs.
acquisition.fixed_six_replay: Acquire every remaining event required to reach six reconciled events in every current agent-skill cell. This must reproduce the CG-5 supplemental event count and serves as the measurement-cost reference.

evaluation.primary_metric: mean expected mission success under revised coverage retrieval
evaluation.cost_metric: mean supplemental probe events per Field

selection_rule.choice: Choose the first decision_adaptive budget in complexity_order satisfying every requirement. If none qualifies, CG-6 calibration selects no architecture and no fresh confirmatory cohort may be generated. No post-hoc substitution with uncertainty-only or uniform policies is allowed.
